title: Crowdsec Insights
description: Detection trends, source workload and telemetry quality. No raw attacker identities are exported by these metrics.

panels.title: What these insights can and cannot show

options.content: **Overflows** describe scenario activity, not unique attackers. Tests and internal events are included in native counters. The email report separates them using LAPI event data and identifies service + host, IP, country and ASN. Those dimensions cannot be invented from aggregate metrics. Current retained alerts and active decision records are separate inventories.

panels.title: Parser successes by host — selected range
Parser success share of evaluated lines
panels.description: Success / evaluated parser lines. Not parser-node traversal ratio. No observations gives N/A, not 100%.

panels.title: Allowlist node matches by reason — selected range
Scrape success share — selected range
panels.description: Only observed samples. Combine with sample coverage; downtime in Prometheus itself is not counted as failed scrapes.

panels.title: Sample coverage — expected 30s scrape
panels.description: Approximation for the configured 30-second cadence. Adjust denominator if scrape interval differs. Shows newly added targets/history gaps.

panels.title: Observed process start changes — selected range
Current engine versions
panels.description: Read the version label; the info metric value is intentionally zero.

panels.title: Decision and alert context — central LAPI
Retained alerts by scenario
panels.description: Retention inventory, not selected-range alert arrivals. Metric labels may aggregate events at the central API.

options.content: Internal-only services can be quiet. A missing lazy scenario counter is not proof that acquisition is broken: inspect input, parser successes, scrape coverage and the named source. Empty per-event tables may be normal. AppSec metrics, per-IP geography and Cloudflare request/challenge totals are not available in these native metrics and are not replaced with fabricated zeros.

panels.title: Nginx automatic update status
panels.description: Current native controller + independent watcher evidence. No change is a successful check, not a deployed upgrade. Same-pin acceptance is validation. In progress requires a running native service; stale evidence is not healthy.

panels.title: Pending nginx advisory reviews
panels.description: Unacknowledged advisory revisions, not CVE counts. An out-of-policy candidate also sets REVIEW NEEDED even when this is zero.

panels.title: Failed automatic transactions — rolling 24h
panels.description: Retained automatic journal outcomes: rejected preflight, incomplete recovery, or rollback. Excludes acceptance/rehearsal/audit. Failures before journaling are visible in current status, not this count.

panels.title: Production rollbacks — rolling 24h
panels.description: Retained automatic transactions with a changed candidate and completed rollback. Also included in failed transaction count; not additive. Incomplete rollback is RECOVERY REQUIRED, not completed rollback.
